---
pagetitle: "LifeFlow — Python life actuarial cash-flow & BEL engine"
description: "LifeFlow is a fast, vectorized Python library for life-insurance cash-flow projection and Best Estimate Liability (BEL): automate reserve calculations and project your own cash flows, efficiently with numba."
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<section class="lf-hero">
  <div class="lf-hero-inner">
    <div class="lf-hero-text">
      <h1>LifeFlow<span class="dot">.</span></h1>
      <p class="lf-tagline">
        Project life-insurance cash flows and compute the reserves. Write your
        own flows as plain Python; LifeFlow vectorizes them across the whole
        portfolio as <strong>N × T</strong> grids and compiles the hot paths
        with numba.
      </p>
      <div class="lf-cta">
        <a class="lf-btn lf-btn-primary" href="example.html">Get started →</a>
        <a class="lf-btn lf-btn-ghost" href="https://github.com/SergiActuary/lifeflow">GitHub</a>
        <a class="lf-btn lf-btn-ghost" href="https://pypi.org/project/lifeflow/">PyPI</a>
      </div>
      <div class="lf-install">pip install <code>lifeflow</code></div>
    </div>

    <div class="lf-window">
      <div class="lf-window-head">
        <span class="d"></span><span class="d"></span><span class="d"></span>
        <span class="t">reserve.py</span>
      </div>
<pre><code><span class="k">import</span> lifeflow <span class="k">as</span> lf

port = lf.Portfolio(df, <span class="s">"id"</span>)
prob = lf.Probabilities(port, [qx])

<span class="k">@lf.grid</span>(port, tl)
<span class="k">def</span> death_benefit(t, capital):
    <span class="k">return</span> capital

<span class="c"># reserve = amount × probability × discount</span>
reserve = (death_benefit()
           * prob.exit_by(qx)
           * discount).sum(axis=<span class="s">1</span>)</code></pre>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="lf-section">
  <h2 class="lf-big">LifeFlow computes reserves for life-insurance portfolios</h2>
  <p class="sub">Easy to write, flexible to your product, and fast at scale.</p>
  <div class="lf-grid3">

    <div class="lf-card">
      <div class="lf-ic">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v3.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2V16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h1"/><path d="M16 3h1a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v3.5a2 2 0 0 0 2 2 2 2 0 0 0-2 2V16a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-1"/></svg>
      </div>
      <h3>Easy to code</h3>
      <div class="lf-feat"><strong>Object-oriented</strong> — the repetitive calculations are automated inside objects, so your own code stays clean.</div>
      <div class="lf-feat"><strong>Decorators</strong> — ready-made decorators simplify building each calculation and guide you through defining the flows.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="lf-card">
      <div class="lf-ic">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/><path d="M9 5v4M15 10v4M7 15v4"/></svg>
      </div>
      <h3>Yours to shape</h3>
      <div class="lf-feat"><strong>Your flows, your rules</strong> — define the shape of every flow yourself: use conditions and any portfolio variable you need.</div>
      <div class="lf-feat"><strong>You stay in control</strong> — LifeFlow expects you to drive. It hands you the tools and gets out of the way, so you can fit it to your exact product.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="lf-card">
      <div class="lf-ic">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13 2 4 14h7l-1 8 9-12h-7l1-8z"/></svg>
      </div>
      <h3>Computationally efficient</h3>
      <div class="lf-feat"><strong>Fast foundations</strong> — built on powerful Python libraries designed for fast, parallelizable numerical work.</div>
      <div class="lf-feat"><strong>Speed without losing clarity</strong> — the grid design keeps calculations fast <em>and</em> easy to audit and review.</div>
      <div class="lf-feat lf-feat-note">Rust modules for a few specific processes are on the roadmap.</div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="lf-band">
  <div class="lf-band-inner">
    <div class="lf-band-tag">complement · not a replacement</div>
    <h2>LifeFlow works <em>with</em> numpy, not instead of it</h2>
    <p class="lf-band-lead">LifeFlow doesn't box you into closed-form formulas. It gives the actuary a
    small set of tools — an object-oriented engine for in-force and exit
    probabilities, and decorators to project cash flows — so you keep
    <strong>total control of the numbers</strong> while the boilerplate and the
    performance are taken care of.</p>
    <div class="lf-band-split">
      <div class="lf-band-col">

        <div class="lf-band-k">LifeFlow</div>
        <p>The actuarial structure and the speed.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="lf-band-foot">Ideal for moving <strong>Excel calculations to
    Python</strong> and standardizing them into a calculation flow that is easy to
    design, reproducible and fast.</p>
  </div>
</section>
```
